newsitem.title: USA: Baxter CEO 1996 salary, bonus at $1.515 mln.
newsitem.headline: Baxter CEO 1996 salary, bonus at $1.515 mln.

text.p: Vernon Loucks, chairman and chief executive officer of Baxter International Inc, was paid a 1996 salary of $715,000 and a bonus of $800,000, a regulatory filing showed.
In a proxy filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Baxter said Loucks earned the bonus because the company exceeded its goals for net income growth and operational cash flow.
Loucks received premium-priced stock options representing 221,600 shares of common stock, twice the number of options he received in 1995, the filing said.
A shared investment option was also granted to Loucks, representing an additional 175,000 common shares, Baxter said in the filing.

The exercise price for premium-priced options is $51 per share for options that expire November 17, 2006. The exercise price for the shared investment plan related stock option is $42.13 per share for options expiring November 27, 2006.

Loucks also received 18,000 shares of restricted stock, the balance of 65,000 shares granted over a five-year period ended December 31, 1996. The stock grant was based on Baxter's performance and total rate of return to shareholders.
